messages:
olivia: Noticed the Python quickstart codeblock is stale. It shows `RedwoodClient(api_key=...)` and a `generate()` call. Running it after upgrading to 0.9.2 raises TypeError on init. Also the docs sidebar link to streaming points to a 404.

ton y: Oof. Which page exactly and what error log?

olivia: Page = https://docs.redwood.ai/python-quickstart. Snippet copied: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])

async def main():
    resp = await client.generate('Hello')
    print(resp.text)
```
Error: TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'api_key'

dev-docs: Thanks, filing this now. Rapid notes: SDK split sync/async and renamed auth param to `token`. New async usage is `RedwoodAsyncClient(token=...)` and API surface uses `.chat.create` / `.completion` rather than `generate`. Also async client should be used with `async with` to close transports.

marc: Example fixed locally: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodAsyncClient
import os

client = RedwoodAsyncClient(token=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))

async def main():
    async with client:
        resp = await client.chat.create(messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
        print(resp.output_text)
```
This clears the init error.

olivia: Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) docs link is 404 (it was pointing to /python/async-streaming). 2) mypy says `chat.create` returns Any so we have to ignore types everywhere. Any ETA on typed stubs?

dev-docs: I broke that redirect when reorganizing pages, sorry. I'll open a PR to correct quickstart snippets and re-add the streaming anchor. For types: we have a types-extra in flight, plan to ship a pyi bundle as `redwood-sdk[types]` next week. You can use the branch `types-preview` if you need it now (`pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk@types-preview`).

ton y: Also, retry/backoff behavior is unclear in the quickstart. We hit intermittent 429s and 5xx and had no default backoff documented. Can we add a short section describing defaults and how to customize RetryPolicy?

dev-docs: Good call — adding a "Retries & Errors" snippet to quickstart. Default plan: 3 retries for 5xx with exponential backoff + jitter, 2 for 429, configurable via `RetryPolicy`. Example to include: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RetryPolicy
client = RedwoodClient(token=..., retry_policy=RetryPolicy(max_retries=5, backoff='exponential'))
```
Will also show how to annotate for mypy with the types-extra.

marc: One more: streaming in async currently requires a separate websocket helper. Can we expose an async iterator on `chat.stream(...)` so it `async for chunk in client.chat.stream(...)` and avoid direct websocket usage?

dev-docs: Filed FR DEVEX-439 to unify streaming into the async client and add docs. We'll try to ship an iterator-based API in the next minor.
